<databaseChangeLog
        xmlns="http://www.liquibase.org/xml/ns/dbchangelog"
        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
        xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.liquibase.org/xml/ns/dbchangelog http://www.liquibase.org/xml/ns/dbchangelog/dbchangelog-4.9.xsd">

    <changeSet id="01-initial-schema" author="sbegaudeau">
        <sql dbms="postgresql">
            CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
        </sql>

        <createTable tableName="project">
            <column name="id"  type="UUID" defaultValueComputed="gen_random_uuid()">
                <constraints nullable="false" primaryKey="true"/>
            </column>
            <column name="name" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="created_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="last_modified_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
        </createTable>
        <sql>
            ALTER TABLE project ADD CONSTRAINT project_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) > 0 AND char_length(name) <= 1024)
        </sql>

        <createTable tableName="nature">
            <column name="project_id" type="UUID">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="name" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
        </createTable>
        <addUniqueConstraint tableName="nature" columnNames="project_id, name"/>
        <addForeignKeyConstraint baseTableName="nature" baseColumnNames="project_id" constraintName="fk_nature_project_id" referencedTableName="project" referencedColumnNames="id" onDelete="CASCADE"/>
        <sql>
            ALTER TABLE nature ADD CONSTRAINT nature_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) > 0 AND char_length(name) <= 1024)
        </sql>

        <createTable tableName="representation_data">
            <column name="id"  type="UUID" defaultValueComputed="gen_random_uuid()">
                <constraints nullable="false" primaryKey="true"/>
            </column>
            <column name="project_id" type="UUID">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="target_object_id" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="description_id" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="label" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="kind" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="content" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="created_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="last_modified_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
        </createTable>
        <addForeignKeyConstraint baseTableName="representation_data" baseColumnNames="project_id" constraintName="fk_representation_data_project_id" referencedTableName="project" referencedColumnNames="id" onDelete="CASCADE"/>
        
        
        <createTable tableName="semantic_data">
            <column name="id"  type="UUID" defaultValueComputed="gen_random_uuid()">
                <constraints nullable="false" primaryKey="true"/>
            </column>
            <column name="project_id" type="UUID">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="created_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="last_modified_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
        </createTable>
        <addForeignKeyConstraint baseTableName="semantic_data" baseColumnNames="project_id" constraintName="fk_semantic_data_project_id" referencedTableName="project" referencedColumnNames="id" onDelete="CASCADE"/>

        <createTable tableName="document">
            <column name="id"  type="UUID" defaultValueComputed="gen_random_uuid()">
                <constraints nullable="false" primaryKey="true"/>
            </column>
            <column name="semantic_data_id" type="UUID">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="name" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="content" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="created_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="last_modified_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
        </createTable>
        <addForeignKeyConstraint baseTableName="document" baseColumnNames="semantic_data_id" constraintName="fk_document_semantic_data_id" referencedTableName="semantic_data" referencedColumnNames="id" onDelete="CASCADE"/>

    </changeSet>
</databaseChangeLog>

            <column name="id"  type="UUID">
                <constraints nullable="false" primaryKey="true"/>
            </column>
            <column name="content" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="last_migration_performed" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="migration_version" type="TEXT">
                <constraints nullable="false"/>
            </column>
            <column name="created_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
            <column name="last_modified_on" type="TIMESTAMPTZ">
                <constraints nullable="false" />
            </column>
        </createTable>
        <addForeignKeyConstraint baseTableName="representation_content" baseColumnNames="id" constraintName="fk_representation_content_id" referencedTableName="representation_data" referencedColumnNames="id" onDelete="CASCADE"/>

        <sql>
            INSERT INTO representation_content (
                id,
                content,
                last_migration_performed,
                migration_version,
                created_on,
                last_modified_on
            )
            SELECT
                representationData.id,
                representationData.content,
                representationData.last_migration_performed,
                representationData.migration_version,
                representationData.created_on,
                representationData.last_modified_on
            FROM representation_data representationData
        </sql>

        <dropColumn tableName="representation_data" columnName="content" />
        <dropColumn tableName="representation_data" columnName="last_migration_performed" />
        <dropColumn tableName="representation_data" columnName="migration_version" />

        <renameTable oldTableName="representation_data" newTableName="representation_metadata" />
    </changeSet>
</databaseChangeLog>
